title: Cultural Fusion
detail: Blend Kerala motifs with Bengaluru street art for a modern, local feel.

title: Floral Archways
detail: Hang flower garlands and mango branches to create welcoming arches at entry points.

title: Sweet Treats
detail: Set up a dessert table with Payasam, Kheer, and traditional sweet snacks.

title: Local Folk Performers
detail: Invite local folk groups to perform Kathakali-inspired dances and traditional music.

title: Onam Biryani
detail: Serve fragrant, vegetable biryani with raita and a side of spicy pickle.

title: Lively Street‑Festival
detail: Inspired by Punjabi street fairs, featuring vibrant stalls, lanterns, and playful decor that echo a bustling celebration.

title: Floral Lanterns
detail: Hang lanterns with mixed flowers in bright colors, adding a festive glow to the setting.

title: Punjabi Feast
detail: Include butter chicken, paneer tikka, and a variety of tandoori dishes served with butter naan and rice.

title: Dhol Band
detail: A lively dhol ensemble for the baraat, ensuring a big, loud, and colourful entrance.

title: Glamorous Fusion
detail: Combine traditional Punjabi elements with a modern twist, using sparkling lights and contemporary patterns.

title: Fairy Tale Carousel
detail: Create a carousel backdrop with printed cardboard horses, tie them with pink streamers, and add glittery paper stars.

title: DIY Balloon Arch
detail: Create a balloon arch in pink and purple using inexpensive balloons tied to a cardboard frame.

title: Homemade Cupcakes
detail: Bake cupcakes, frost them in pastel pink, top with a small pink topper, and give each child a cupcake as a treat.

title: DIY Crown Craft
detail: Provide plain cardboard crowns, stickers, and colored paper for kids to decorate their own princess crowns.

title: Enchanted Garden
detail: Use flower garlands in pastel pinks and purples, hanging paper lanterns, and a DIY flower arch made from foam and ribbons.

title: Natural Heritage
detail: Celebrate Bengaluru’s green heritage with potted plants and bamboo accents for a calm, elegant vibe.

title: Paper Flower Accents
detail: Use handcrafted paper flowers in modest sizes as table centerpieces and wall decor.

title: Halal Buffet Stations
detail: Set up separate buffet stalls with biryani, grilled kebabs, and vegetarian curries, all certified halal.

title: Live Acoustic Ensemble
detail: Invite a local folk band to play soft, traditional tunes that complement the event’s calm tone.

title: Interactive Games
detail: Include simple outdoor games like ring toss and sack races for all ages.
